messages:
jamie: PTAL at PR #482 — addressed comments, added unit test for kv-eviction edge, and updated smoke script. CI is green locally but GH Actions is flaky. I can squash or keep commits if you prefer. Need one more approval before the canary window today at 3pm PT.
sara: looking now, thanks. Quick q: did you change the default batching size in config? I see a default bump in the first commit.
jamie: yeah just increased default batch to 64 for GPUs with >48GB — added conditional so it shouldn't affect small infra. Diff: config/runtime.yaml +3 lines. If we want no config drift I can revert and gate behind a feature flag.
pranay: lgtm on tests. small nit: rename var 'max_batch' -> 'batch_limit' for clarity. not blocking.
jamie: done, pushed fix (squash). Also added smoke command in README: ./scripts/run_smoke.sh --dataset tiny
ci-bot: build passed on main, tests: 152/153 (1 flaky - test_integration_rpc). Rerun with /retest?
sara: /retest from me. If flaky test still fails, we can merge and follow up since it's unrelated to batching.
michael: I'm OOO until 2pm PT; will approve after lunch if still open. @sara you ok to approve and merge if jamie wants earlier?
jamie: yes please, if you can approve that'll let us hit canary. I don't mind if we open a rollback PR if that flaky test surfaces.
sara: approved. :thumbsup: merging into canary slot now. Jamie's oncall — ping if anything weird.
jamie: thanks. Will watch logs and metric alerts for the next hour.
pranay: quick follow-up — can we add a small alert for outgoing queue growth? put it in a follow-up PR.
jamie: added a TODO in the merge commit msg. Will file follow-up ticket.
